card.fires_on: Mid-term pieces such as the 'yl' in prophylaxis, the 'ap' in quetiapine, and the word 'handling' in 'special handling and disposal'. These sit in drug-label dosing and preparation sections.

modes.description: Fires on a middle piece of a longer drug or medical word, such as prophylaxis or quetiapine.

modes.description: Fires on 'handling' in the hazardous-drug instruction 'special handling and disposal procedures'.
